objective: 持续优化 EmbodiedForge 三个实际小时，保留已有改动，完成测量、回归和持续验证。
changes: Partial active-row NumPy physics gathers independent plain float64 state buffers once, preserves every Euler operation and scatters after substeps. Constant control delta is evaluated once.
All-active, all-frozen, single-substep, aliased/subclass/non-float64 buffers and strict floating-error modes retain the previous path.
Reference benchmark accepts --substeps, default 4; thirteen regression cases cover aliases/layouts and completed substeps before a floating error.
scope: Synthetic two-dimensional CPU point-reach reference dynamics; direct control+physics+owned snapshot and complete no-camera VectorEnv.step. No MuJoCo, GPU or training-throughput claim.
performance_caveats: Three Python/NumPy environments, 72 scenarios each, 21 alternating pairs, one pinned CPU on a shared host. Construction/warmup/tracing/digests excluded from timing.

All signed results retained. Some tiny unchanged controls fluctuate; speed claims are scoped to the explicitly plotted 1024-environment cases. First versioned measurements preceded the cohorts; later runs overlapped pinned cohorts and/or CI.
Transient allocation peaks are separately traced, not RSS. No general memory reduction claim.

figure.scope: Selected 1024-environment scenarios; all 72 scenarios per version retained in raw reports.

superseded_harness.classification: Three intermediate sessions actually stopped with exit 143 and reaped before strengthening post-failure byte capture and object-release checks. Runtime source unchanged; intermediate progress is not counted as completed final cohorts.

inherited_diagnostic.scope: Previous MotionClips input fingerprint anomaly retained unchanged. This round changes a separate physics component and does not classify or erase that historical event.

round_scope: Three-hour wall-clock round includes analysis, implementation, measurements, final-source CI, strengthened harness controls, sustained differential validation and export. Cohort durations are individually reported; no parallel durations are added.
evidence_selection: Raw measurements, final and superseded harnesses, logs, capture control, inherited failure, initial text/source snapshots, and final changed files/figure retained. Initial binary assets and earlier compressed evidence archives omitted; all their initial hashes remain preserved.

observations: All three processes exited with observed code 120; final reports were absent.
Each left a zero-byte failure.json.tmp and empty stderr log; original exception text was not retained.

Filesystem showed 100% used, 827 MiB free when inspected; inode usage was 5%, RAM available about 29 GiB. Persistence failure under shared disk pressure is plausible, but the initiating exception was not conclusively captured.

validation_interruption.interpretation: Interrupted sessions remain incomplete, not passed. Their observed exit 120, zero-byte temporary reports and last successful progress are preserved. Later successful runs do not conclusively identify the initiating exception; disk pressure is supporting context, not a proven root cause.

persistence_control.scope: Isolated injected ENOSPC control; does not establish the initiating cause of the earlier interruption.

ram_evidence_scope: Restarted final cohorts mirror progress and failure arrays into /dev/shm before root writes, and emit exceptions directly through tool stderr. Mirrors are copied into final archive after actual reaping.
